summary: Mazzei praised Trump in June 2025 for “protecting our ally Israel and securing peace in the Mid East,” framing US–Israel relations positively with no mention of Gaza or Palestinian casualties. A 2016 advocacy-site claim that he co-sponsored an Oklahoma Senate resolution commending Israel is unverified; the recorded Senate log does not name him.

evidence_audit.reason: Office context; no bearing on Palestinian-justice position.
Party affiliation alone does not establish a position on Palestinian justice.
All eight platform points address economy, education, jobs, criminal justice, and immigration; none concern Israel, Palestine, or related speech rights.
